'''Chapter 344''' is called "Opposing Force".

==Cover Page==
[[Gedatsu's Accidental Blue-Sea Life]], Vol. 28: "The Men's Bath".

All men are welcome at [[Ukkari Hot-Spring Island]], be they of the Crown ([[Igaram]], [[Chaka]], [[Pell]]), of the soil ([[Goro]], [[Toto]], [[Koza]]), or of the beasts ([[Matsuge]], [[Karoo]], and the rest of the [[Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops]]).  

==Short Summary==
The [[CP9]] members continue to make light work of the [[Galley-La Company]] while [[Iceburg]] and [[Paulie]] reveal that the [[Pluton|blueprints]] are fake.

==Long Summary==
Enraged at the sight of his two friends defeated, [[Tilestone]] attacks the [[Blueno|bear-masked man]] who easily smashes it to pieces with only his fist. Tilestone, who never loses in strength, is easily defeated by one blow causing the other carpenters to panic.

Outside the [[Galley-La Headquarters]], the three remaining [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] are seen being chased by a large number of carpenters while wondering where [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] has gone. [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]], sick of being chased, charges at the carpenters while attacking using the back of his swords as to not cause any serious injuries (although [[Nami]] and [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] both state that he still is).

Luffy, who is finally free, uses [[Gomu Gomu no Mi|Gomu Gomu Rocket]] to get into the Galley-La Headquarters.

In [[Iceburg]]'s room, he laughs that he never expected to meet [[Nico Robin|Robin]] like this. Iceburg suddenly draw guns and he states that he wants to kill her as she is the only one who could revive the ancient weapons written in [[Void Century|True History]]. Robin says that Iceburg is an outsider to this however, he reveals that he hold [[Pluton|blueprints]] to the ancient weapon Pluton. He explains that the blueprints were handed down to him from [[Tom]] and that he should have burned them when the [[World Government]] found out. As he is about to pull the trigger, Robin restrains him and he states that the group who have really been deceived is [[CP9]].

In the President's Room, [[Paulie]] still has the blueprints tightly in his grasp despite being covered in blood. As he falls to the ground defeated, he informs the two masked men that the blueprints are fakes.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*The bear-masked man defeats the [[Dock 1]] shipwrights.
*As [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]], [[Nami]], and [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] are being chased by the shipwrights, Zoro decides to charge through them into the mansion.
**To avoid fatally wounding the shipwrights, as they are not their true enemies, Zoro decides to use the back of his swords.
**Due to Zoro's extraordinary strength, Nami points out that Zoro is still seriously injuring them.
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] manages to escape the buildings he was stuck in and propels himself towards the mansion.
*It is revealed that [[Nico Robin|Robin]] is the only person alive who is able to decipher [[Poneglyph]]s, which is why she had a high bounty placed on her as a child.
**Due to this, [[Iceburg]] suspects that Robin plans to destroy the world, deciphering the Poneglyphs to resurrect the ancient weapons.
**The incident which lead to Robin's bounty is revealed to be on an island known as [[Ohara]].
*Iceburg reveals that he currently is in possession of the blueprints of the ancient weapon, [[Pluton]].
**It is also revealed that Iceburg's Pluton blueprints that [[Paulie]] retrieved are fake.
